KNOWN LIMIT: TeX loads the metric (eufm10.tfm is bundled) and the WOFF2 face ships (eufm*.woff2), but dvi2html reads metrics from its own built-in table when it parses the DVI, and that table has no Euler fonts. Fixing this means a font hook in, or a fork of, @drgrice1/dvi2html.
